name: Badland 2 Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: An enhanced, native port of Badland 2 (Android) for the PlayStation Vita and PlayStation TV, powered by an ARMv7 dynamic shared library loader (so-loader), custom FalsoJNI bridge, and vitaGL.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
